title: REAL ID - federal enforcement rules
facts: Federal REAL ID enforcement began May 7, 2025 for federal purposes covered by the REAL ID Act.

Adults age 18 and older using a state-issued driver's license or identification card at TSA airport security checkpoints must present a REAL ID-compliant card or another TSA-acceptable form of identification.
REAL ID does not create a federal driver's license; states and territories issue the cards under federal standards.
A passport or certain other federally accepted identification can be used instead of a REAL ID for TSA identity purposes.
